title: Multiplicativity of binary characters
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $x,y\in(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^n$. The character associated with $S$ satisfies $\chi_S(x+y)=\chi_S(x)\chi_S(y)$.
